name: pawn-helper
description: Pawn language helpers for color literals and workspace symbol navigation.

commands.title: Pawn Helper: Generate Enum from CREATE TABLE

livePawnHelper.colors.enabled.description: Highlight Pawn color literals and named defines that contain color values.

livePawnHelper.colors.variables.enabled.description: Highlight uses of named color variables and defines separately from raw color literals.

livePawnHelper.constants.valueHints.enab.description: Show inline value hints for named #define, const, and enum constants with simple numeric values.

livePawnHelper.definitions.enabled.description: Enable go-to-definition for Pawn symbols indexed by this extension.

livePawnHelper.sql.highlighting.enabled.description: Highlight SQL keywords and mysql_format placeholders inside SQL string literals.

livePawnHelper.sql.diagnostics.enabled.description: Warn when mysql_format placeholder counts do not match provided arguments.

livePawnHelper.index.include.description: Workspace globs used to index Pawn files.

livePawnHelper.index.exclude.description: Workspace globs excluded from Pawn indexing.

livePawnHelper.index.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of Pawn files to index.

livePawnHelper.index.debounceMs.description: Delay before rebuilding the index after document or workspace changes.

livePawnHelper.index.documentDebounceMs.description: Delay before updating the index for the edited Pawn document.
